episodes.title: Her "Xs"
episodes.summary: When Sung-hee attempts to expose Ah-jin's secrets, she strikes back with the help of fellow classmates.

episodes.title: The Moment a Human Becomes a Devil
episodes.summary: Ah-jin is accepted into her dream law school, but her dreams are crushed when her father returns.

episodes.title: Breaking the Shackles
episodes.summary: With her dream shattered, Ah-jin begins to work at a cafe and secretly schemes to manipulate Jung-ho.

episodes.title: No Turning Back
episodes.summary: As suspicions fall on Ah-jin with nowhere to turn, she is approached by Mi-ri, who steps in to save her.

episodes.title: Grant me The Power to Rise to the Top
episodes.summary: Ah-jin makes her debut as an actress and grows increasingly wary of Lena.

episodes.title: Setting the Trap
episodes.summary: Determined to advance her career, Ah-jin sets her sights on top star, Heo In-gang.

episodes.title: The Wheel of Fate
episodes.summary: Ah-jin's year-long romance with In-gang deepens, but her past is at risk of being exposed.

episodes.title: Before Judgment
episodes.summary: After his grandmother's passing, In-gang proposes, but Ah-jin ends their relationship instead.

episodes.title: New Heights
episodes.summary: As Ah-jin faces public backlash for her break up with In-gang, a wealthy savior comes to her rescue.

episodes.title: The Monster in the Mirror
episodes.summary: Jun-seo learns the secret of his birth and leaves Ah-jin's side while she marries Do-hyuk.

episodes.title: Save Me, My God
episodes.summary: Ah-jin discovers the unnerving truth about her husband. Desperate to break free, she turns to Jae-oh.

episodes.title: The Final X
episodes.summary: Ah-jin's deepest darkest secrets are revealed just as she rises to the very top.
